requirements.statement: A non-Bevy supervisor runs the shell-to-world-to-shell replacement-process product loop using atomic launch intents.
acceptance: The menu-driven product smoke returns to shell after durable world shutdown.
Stale intents, child crashes and lease conflicts fail into bounded recovery.

requirements.statement: Versioned child exit reports and one-shot launch intents distinguish durable transitions from crashes without restart loops.
acceptance: Only a durable game exit with a matching Shell intent returns through the normal shell path; written-only, timeout and crash paths enter recovery.
Intent generations are atomically acknowledged or quarantined and a failed generation is never automatically replayed.
